info.title: Sqwakie local API
info.description: The daemon's local HTTP API under /v1, served on the unix socket ~/.walkie/walkie.sock (owner uid, no token) and on 127.0.0.1:7457 (bearer token from ~/.walkie/local.token, or a dashboard session in X-Walkie-Session, which reaches only the dashboard's routes). Used by the CLI, the dashboard and MCP. It does NOT cover the peer API between machines, the relay or the phone tunnel's wire format, the dashboard's static files, GET /auth and POST /auth/logout on the loopback listener, or the response bodies the handlers build from the daemon's views (those are described as objects with additionalProperties: true unless the handler returns a literal shape). `version` is the daemon release this document was last checked against, not a promise of stability; docs/PROTOCOL.md section 5 is the prose reference. Every operation also answers 404 not_found (no such route) and 405 method_not_allowed for another method on a known path; every error body is {error:{code,message,...}}. Writes from an agent-marked caller (X-Walkie-Agent, or X-Walkie-Under-Agent: 1) are subject to the guards named in x-walkie-guards and x-walkie-agent-policy; the reserved agent name 'orchestrator' needs X-Walkie-Orchestrator-Token.
